summary: Full backend + frontend E2E testing of PropTriage Phase 1. Backend: 24 pytest cases across /api/config, public issue creation, resident lookup/reply, auth protection (cookie + Bearer), issue list/detail/stats, PATCH enum validation + system logging, staff messaging. 23/24 passed (only failure is an intentional negative test proving assigned_team is not validated). Frontend: resident portal submit (category empty) with success toast + My Requests lookup with status badge; /staff redirect to login when unauthenticated; staff dashboard with injected session cookie rendering all columns, stats, search + status filters, detail Sheet with Status/Priority/Lane/Team dropdowns persisting to DB and appending system interactions, staff message appended and persisted after refresh, logout clearing session. No blocking issues found.

minor.issue: assigned_team accepts any arbitrary string (e.g. 'TEST_NotATeam') and returns 200; status/lane/priority are validated but team is not checked against TEAM_VALUES. Should return 400 for unknown team (allow null to unassign).
No length/whitespace validation: empty-string name/unit/message pass Pydantic and create an issue. Recommend min_length constraints + trimming (frontend does block empty, backend does not).

Resident matching is on exact name+unit string, so 'maria garcia' vs 'Maria Garcia' or trailing spaces creates a duplicate resident record; My Requests lookup then misses prior requests. Consider case-insensitive/trimmed matching.
Returns 200 for a create; 201 would be more correct.

ui_bugs.issue: Radix a11y console error on every open: 'DialogContent requires a DialogTitle'. Add a SheetTitle (wrap in VisuallyHidden if not visually needed).

issues: Lane/status are shown title-cased ('Resolve', 'Review') in the table/dropdowns while backend enum is RESOLVE/REVIEW and the system timeline log says 'Lane set to RESOLVE' - slightly inconsistent wording for staff, cosmetic only.
Sidebar has only a single 'All Issues' item with a lot of empty space; fine for MVP but looks unfinished.

action_items: Validate assigned_team against TEAM_VALUES in PATCH /api/issues/{id} (return 400 on unknown team).
Add server-side validation (min_length / strip) for name, unit, message on POST /api/issues.
Add a SheetTitle (VisuallyHidden) to IssueDetailSheet to remove the Radix accessibility console error.
Optional: case-insensitive + trimmed resident matching so 'My Requests' lookup is reliable.
critical_code_review_comments: list_issues does one residents.find_one per issue (N+1 queries). Fine for 5 issues, but batch with a single $in query before scale.

POST /api/residents/requests and POST /api/issues silently fall back to 'the first property' via find_one({}); with multiple properties this becomes non-deterministic. Scope by property_id explicitly.
Auth cookie/Bearer handling, _id exclusion, async motor usage and status codes all look correct; no blocking code issues.

success_rate.backend: 96% (23/24; single failure is a negative test for missing team validation)

seed_data_creation: Injected staff user test-user-qa-1 / session token test_session_qa_1 into test_database (users, user_sessions) and created TEST_-prefixed residents/issues; ALL of it was deleted after testing. DB restored to seeded state: 1 property, 50 residents, 5 issues.
test_credentials: No app passwords. /app/memory/test_credentials.md is accurate; session-injection per /app/auth_testing.md works (cookie session_token or Authorization: Bearer).
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py uses SESSION_TOKEN='test_session_qa_1' - re-inject the user/session in mongo (users.user_id='test-user-qa-1') before running, since cleanup removed it. Playwright staff tests need context.add_cookies session_token on domain triage-skeleton.preview.emergentagent.com. Lane/Status dropdown options are title-cased ('Resolve', 'In Progress'), not enum-cased. All 5 seeded issues + 50 residents intact.
rca_of_the_issue: assigned_team failure RCA: update_issue validates status/lane/priority against their enum lists but assigns payload.assigned_team directly to updates without a TEAM_VALUES membership check (server.py lines 333-335), so any string persists and shows in the dashboard 'Assigned Team' column.
